comments_03.text: Confidentiality should not apply here. The service passes requests on and keeps nothing itself.

comments_03.author: assistant
comments_03.text: Agreed. The certificate service stores nothing of its own; the requests it handles are covered by AS-05 Certificate records. Under the D-22 rule this cell should be off.
